profile.headline: Software Engineer III @ Tinder
profile.summary:
Having worked on a variety of IBM HyperBlue AI startups and teams, I am no stranger to change. I am used to working in high-stakes fast moving teams to deliver impact and innovation. Learning a new language, framework, or prompt engineering a new model from one week to another is a part of the job and it keeps my software development skills sharp every day.

I currently work at Tinder, as a backend engineer. Here, I work mostly in Java and put my prompting skills to the test every day in this AI-native organization. Check out the tech blog covering my latest work on Tinder's smartphotos in one of my recent posts!

projects.title: Evaluation Pipeline Leveraging Incremental Labeling
projects.description:
Created a system that takes in and parses CSV files to filter relevant information and organize filtered columns by importance. This Java code also references a baseline set and a generated set of files listed in the CSV and detects changes, updating the baseline set if the a generated set file were to become more correct than the baseline copy. This is grouped into Gradle tasks that a user runs on the command line using two shell scripts.

The idea is to avoid the need to spend man hours labeling ground truth data and instead leverage incremental labeling of the data to determine improvements or regressions of files run through a PDF to HTML conversion algorithm, which is stored in a historical CSV.

projects.title: Web-based IT Management Software
projects.description: Created a web-based solution to manage pieces of IT equipment using Vue.js, ASP.NET and MsSQL. Included CRUD actions for server equipment tables and rack diagrams. Allowed for creating of used profiles and tracking of user permissions to access parts of the website.
